name: phabricator-review-vscode
description: Review and create revisions on Mozilla's Phabricator instance.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Sign in to Mozilla Phabricator to review revisions.

[Sign In](command:phabricator.signIn)

This extension uses a Conduit API token from [phabricator.services.mozilla.com](https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/conduit/login).

commands.title: Update Revision from Commit via moz-phab
Check Out Revision in Sparse Worktree

phabricator.baseUrl.description: Conduit API base URL. Must end with /api/.

phabricator.refreshIntervalSeconds.description: How often to poll Phabricator for revision updates while the editor is focused.

phabricator.landoBaseUrl.description: Base URL used by the 'View in Lando' command. The revision id is appended to this URL.

phabricator.searchfoxRepo.description: Searchfox repository identifier used when generating links from the composer (e.g. firefox-main, mozilla-central, comm-central).

phabricator.defaultRepository.description: Default Phabricator repository used when submitting revisions. Accepts a /source/<shortName>/ URL, a shortName, a callsign, or a PHID.

phabricator.mozPhabPath.description: Path to the `moz-phab` executable used to submit commits.

phabricator.firefoxSourcePath.description: Absolute path to your full Firefox checkout used as the source for sparse worktrees. When empty, the active repository, then $FIREFOX_SOURCE, then ~/firefox are tried.

phabricator.worktreeStorageRoot.description: Root directory under which sparse worktrees are created, laid out as <root>/<repoName>/patch-D<id>. When empty, $WORKTREE_STORAGE_ROOT, then <firefoxSourcePath>/.worktrees are used.

phabricator.worktreeSparsePreset.description: Sparse-checkout preset for new revision worktrees. 'auto' picks 'frontend' when the source mozconfig enables artifact builds, else 'base'. 'full'/'none' check out the entire tree.

phabricator.anchorReviewToWorktree.description: When a revision is checked out in a sparse worktree, anchor its diffs and inline comments to that real worktree (native git: diffs on the actual files) instead of the synthetic phab:// documents. Falls back to phab:// automatically when no worktree is available.

phabricator.worktreeDiffBase.description: Which git ref the 'before' side of a worktree-anchored diff compares against. 'parent' uses the patched commit's first parent (correct for a single revision); 'mergeBase' diffs against origin/main (useful for stacks).

phabricator.worktreeAutoUpdateOnNewDiff.description: How to handle a checked-out worktree when a newer diff is uploaded to its revision. 'prompt' asks before force-re-patching (discards uncommitted worktree edits); 'auto' re-patches without asking; 'off' leaves the worktree alone and falls back to the synthetic phab:// diff.

scripts.test: npm run test:client && npm run test:webviews
